meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 涉及Git操作时,它会先并行收集状态/日志/分支信息,识别仓库提交风格,再按改动文件数强制拆分多个原子提交;也处理rebase/squash历史重写和blame/bisect/log -S历史查询。
howto.when: 当你需要提交代码、用 rebase/squash 整理历史,或查找某改动是谁在何时引入时触发。

say.text: 把这次改动的 5 个文件拆成合适的多个提交
say.note: 会按目录和关注点生成提交计划。

say.text: 把这几个提交用 rebase 压成一个
say.note: 会先检查分支是否已推送,再安全压缩。

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁在哪个提交加的
say.note: 会用 blame 和 log -S 定位来源。

howto.what_en: For any Git request, it gathers status/log/diff, detects commit style, splits changes into multiple atomic commits based on file-count rules, and handles rebase/squash rewrites and history search via blame, bisect, log -S.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to commit changes, tidy up history via rebase/squash, or find who introduced a change and when.

say_en.text: Split these 5 changed files into appropriate multiple commits.
say_en.note: Creates a commit plan grouped by directory and concern.

say_en.text: Squash these commits into one with rebase.
say_en.note: Checks if the branch is pushed before rewriting.

say_en.text: Find which commit added this line and who wrote it.
say_en.note: Uses blame and log -S to trace the origin.
